items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Louie says, "I'm going to get Joe Glaser, because he ain't got nothing.

ctx.x: So when he came out, Louie says, "I'm going to get Joe Glaser, because he ain't got nothing. We both can start out together." And see, of course Joe Glaser's people owned, I think, the ground that the Sunset was setting on, that building. So therefore he was -- they are entitled him -- they let him collect the rent for that property, which paid him something like -- hm -- $150.00 a month, something like that. I don't remember the exact figure, and with that money, and with his being slick, being from the street,…
